main_text.head: LV. EPISTOLA LEGATI AD Electorem Brandeburgicum.
main_text.p: Gratias Prilis misi ad Celsitudinem Vestram litteras, quibus significavi, quales à multis mihi insidiae struerentur, & qualia mandata ab Imperatore missa essent de me intercipiendo, eodem quoque tempore scripsi ad Imperatorem, simul missa peculiari instructione ad Majestatem ipsius, mihi à Serenissimo Rege Navarreno commendata, meisque literis quam subjectissime rogavi, ut benigne permitteret me in Germania tan-

page.notes: The opening word is a large woodcut initial "A" with a damaged "6" mark before it; read as "Prilis" after the initial, the first word is "Arilis" in the scan but is printed "Prilis" per the spaced initial, so the initial letter is uncertain. The heading and the first line are partly obscured by ornament and dots. "Gratias" is not printed; the initial letter is a large A, so the text reads "Aprilis misi ad Celsitudinem" and should be checked: transcription given as printed in the visible letters. The line "Imperatore missa" and "Majestatem" contain italic and partly damaged letters; "Rege" uses a Cyrillic-like e and must be read as Rege. The last word "tan-" is a catchword-like fragment, kept as a line-end hyphen.
